text_block_list.text:
Super Creek won the latest video game in a 
raffle, so we decided to try playing it 
with some help from the gamers on campus.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Mm, character creation looks about done. 
How's this? Creek-san, Turbo.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa~ that's amazing, Taishin-chan! Not 
just the face, even the clothes look 
exactly like her!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, hey! Let's start already! Turbo's 
gonna be the one who beats up the bad 
guys!"
choice_data_list: Um, what kind of game was it again?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"Defeat the nearby enemies => power 
yourself up => defeat the map boss. 
Basically, it's just a loop of that."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"‘Since it's multiplayer, the difficulty 
is pretty high, but... well, we got 
this.’"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Take this! Turbo's big sword! 
Doryaaaaaa!"

The tutorial is going smoothly. Wondering 
how Super Creek is doing, I look over to 
the side and—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"T-Taishin-chan~. About this guy... Do we 
reeeally have to beat him up...?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: "Huh?"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"It's still so small, after all... I know! 
If we feed it and become friends, maybe it 
won't do bad things anymore...!"
choice_data_list:
'S-Small or not, they're still the 
enemy...!'

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"My level went up quite a bit. I got the 
materials too, so after a little more 
grinding, let's hit the boss."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: "Hey! How's it going over there, Creek!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
""Wait, whoa!? Why haven't you defeated 
the enemies!?""

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"This little one was running away from a 
bigger one just now... It barely managed 
to escape, so defeating it feels a bit..."

text_block_list.name: Cute Magical Beast
text_block_list.text: "Kyu-kyuu... Gyuwaaa!!"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: "Eek!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...It might be best for Creek-san to 
stick entirely to a support role."

After struggling here and there, I managed 
to get geared up and challenged the early 
boss. But—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"Dammit! It's so fast, my attacks aren't 
landing at all— ...Wait, that motion...!?"
(BOOOOOOMMMM!!)

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"T-Taishin-chan! Turbo-chan! 
Trainer-san...!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: "Crap! She's still looking over here!"

The only one left standing right now... is 
Super Creek, a total gaming novice who's 
bad at attacking.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: "—I won't let you."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"I won't let you lay another finger... on 
my precious little ones!"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"And for bad little girls who do things 
like that..."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: "Ouuuch, time for your punishment~~!"

text_block_list.name: Boss Beast
text_block_list.text: "GUOOOOOH?!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Whoa. In a single blow.

Their playstyle up until now was purely 
support-oriented, so I thought they were 
actually bad at combat, but...!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Hey! What was that last attack!? The one 
that went BOOM! BAM! WHOOSH! Turbo wants 
to do it too!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Her ultra special move? ...Whoa. Pulling 
that off is super hard, though.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Umm. I just thought I had to protect 
everyone, so—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: How on earth did I pull that off~?
choice_data_list:
So that's what they mean by 'mothers are 
strong'...!

Your kindness is your greatest weapon, 
Creek.

Your kindness is your greatest weapon, 
Creek, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: How on earth did I pull that off~?
choice_data_list:
So that's what they mean by 'mothers are 
strong'...!

Your kindness is your greatest weapon, 
Creek.

Your kindness is your greatest weapon, 
Creek, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Haaah... You can do that?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Then, if I just scramble it all up like 
crazy, will Turbo be able to do it!?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. Shall we try practicing together~?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...I'm definitely gonna learn to do it 
too.

And so, they continued having fun playing 
games after this.

Come to think of it, the reason we haven't 
hit a single Game Over up to this point is 
likely thanks to her attentive healing and 
support.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Totally! Turbo has never gone this long 
without dying in a game before! Thanks a 
bunch, Creek~!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Not at all, the pleasure's mine~. Thank 
you for playing with me♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Not really.

And so, they continued having fun playing 
games after this.
